questions.q: The ratio of red, blue, and yellow marbles in a bag is $3:4:5$. If there are $48$ marbles in total, how many blue marbles are there?
questions.answer: Total ratio parts $= 3 + 4 + 5 = 12$. Each part $= \frac{48}{12} = 4$. Blue marbles $= 4 \times 4 = 16$.

questions.q: If $8$ workers can assemble $120$ computer units in $5$ hours, how many units can $12$ workers assemble in $6$ hours at the same rate?
questions.answer: Rate per worker $= \frac{120}{8 \times 5} = \frac{120}{40} = 3$ units per hour. For $12$ workers working $6$ hours: $12 \times 6 \times 3 = 216$ units.

questions.q: A map has a scale of $1 \text{ cm} : 25 \text{ km}$. If two cities are $7.2$ cm apart on the map, what is the actual distance between them?
An item originally priced at $80$ is on sale for $25\%$ off. An additional $10\%$ tax is then added to the sale price. What is the final total?
A company's revenue increased by $20\%$ in year 1 and then decreased by $15\%$ in year 2. What was the net percent change over the two-year period?
questions.answer: Multiplier $= 1.20 \times 0.85 = 1.02$. This corresponds to a net increase of $2\%$.

questions.q: If $40\%$ of $x$ is equal to $30\%$ of $y$, what is the ratio $\frac{x}{y}$?
A driver travels from City A to City B at an average speed of $60$ km/h and returns along the same route at $40$ km/h. What is the average speed for the round trip?
questions.answer: Harmonic mean of speeds: $\frac{2 v_1 v_2}{v_1 + v_2} = \frac{2(60)(40)}{60 + 40} = \frac{4800}{100} = 48$ km/h.

questions.q: Train A leaves a station traveling east at $80$ km/h. Two hours later, Train B leaves the same station traveling east on a parallel track at $120$ km/h. How many hours after Train B departs will it overtake Train A?
questions.answer: Head start of Train A $= 80 \times 2 = 160$ km. Relative closing speed $= 120 - 80 = 40$ km/h. Time $= \frac{160}{40} = 4$ hours.

questions.q: A cyclist rides $15$ km at $20$ km/h and then another $25$ km at $25$ km/h. What is the total time for the trip in minutes?
questions.answer: Time $1 = \frac{15}{20} = 0.75$ h $= 45$ min. Time $2 = \frac{25}{25} = 1.0$ h $= 60$ min. Total time $= 45 + 60 = 105$ minutes.

questions.q: In a survey of $200$ high school seniors, $120$ plan to attend college, $50$ plan to work, and $30$ are undecided. If a student is chosen at random, what is the probability that the student does NOT plan to work?
questions.answer: Students not planning to work $= 200 - 50 = 150$. Probability $= \frac{150}{200} = \frac{3}{4}$.

questions.q: A two-way table shows that of $80$ male students, $32$ play a sport, and of $120$ female students, $48$ play a sport. What proportion of all students play a sport?
questions.answer: Total sports players $= 32 + 48 = 80$. Total students $= 80 + 120 = 200$. Proportion $= \frac{80}{200} = 0.40$.

questions.q: Given that a student plays a sport from the above group, what is the conditional probability that the student is female?
questions.answer: Among the $80$ sports players, $48$ are female: $\frac{48}{80} = \frac{6}{10} = 0.60$.
